{{Vanilla|Terracotta}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Terracotta''' is fired [[clay]]. In [[Matcha Flavoured]] it is made in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] rather than a furnace, and it can be broken down into [[brick]]s.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
A clay block fired in a mud kiln becomes terracotta (5 seconds); the vanilla furnace recipe is removed. Glazed terracotta is also made in the kiln.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/kiln/terracotta.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
The [[Mason]] sells 1 bulk terracotta for 1 [[obol]] at the apprentice level; it unpacks into 64 terracotta. The item has no English name, so the game shows its translation key.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/mason/2/terracotta.json}}</ref> See [[Bulk blocks]] and [[Known bugs]].

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
Terracotta (plain, white or orange) crafts into 4 [[brick]]s.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/brick_from_terracottas.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History
|{{History line|1.03|Glazed terracotta is made in the mud kiln.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Terracotta can no longer be made in an oven; it is only kilned.}}
